observations.description: Drill root must be new: root.exists() or root.is_symlink() rejects with ValueError. observed_at must be UTC.

All evidence frozen, deterministic, content-addressed: OperationalDrillReportV1 and OperationalDrillObservationV1 are frozen dataclasses. report_id=sha256(core). Deterministic replay produces identical report. 11 unique observations with unique evidence_ids.
Simulated power-loss: first session executes a command, second session acquires and starts (restart), waiting cycle returns RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, exact observation restores connectivity.
Process exception: RuntimeError inside context manager releases lock via __exit__. Lock file is absent after exception. Durable checkpoint remains loadable.
Stale input (6s ago) → HALTED_STALE_INPUT with kill_switch + disconnected. Future input (1us ahead) → HALTED_FUTURE_INPUT. Both durably checkpointed. No recorder operated.
No recorder imports or control functions. No start/stop/btc/es_nq recorder references.
Checkpoint corruption: writing corrupt bytes then attempting restart rejects with exception and releases ownership lock.
Exact command replay: first cycle accepts and creates 1 record/receipt. Second cycle with same command returns IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY. No duplicate order created.
Conflicting reuse: same command_id with different submission (authorized=False) returns COMMAND_CONFLICT without changing exposure.
Reconciliation mismatch: empty observation while disconnected → RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, kill_switch_active, not connected. Durable.
Controlled stop: session_id-bound, stop=True, trading_authority=False. STOPPED state, disconnected, alert emitted.

Cloud-sync alert delivery: local fixture sink with CLOUD_SYNC transport, off_host_attested=True, trading_authority=False. deliver_alerts + verify_delivery return 1. Physical off-host delivery not claimed.
No physical outage claim: physical_outage_claimed=False, recorder_operation_claimed=False. Module docstring states 'neither operate recorders nor claim physical outage'. No soak test claim.
trading_authority=False throughout: observation default False, report default False, alert trading_authority False.

No network/credential/provider/scheduled-task/recorder/wallet/broker/exchange/signing/live imports. Only dataclass, datetime, decimal, hashlib, json, pathlib, contracts, paper modules, off_host_alert_delivery used.

redundant: Some adversarial tests overlap with existing on drill root, determinism, no network
